title: Summer and Garden Anew
author: Quentin Kavanagh
blurb: Sebastian Joubert, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
